name: title-oh
title: Ohio title insurance rating
summary: Rate title insurance in Ohio from a filed schedule of rates: owner's and loan premiums by band, minimums, reissue, refinance and simultaneous issue, endorsements, the actuarial memorandum and the errors in the filings.
description: Each task gives the AI the filed schedule of rates of an Ohio title insurance rating organization, with its rate pages and actuarial memorandum, and states its facts in the question, such as the kind of policy and the amount of insurance. It asks for exact values: a premium, an amount, the rule that applies, a figure in the memorandum, or the errors in the filed pages themselves. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Premium by band
families.what: Owner's and loan premiums by band, with the round-up to the next thousand and the edges of the bands.

families.name: Minimum premium
families.what: Which minimum applies to a policy, also inside a reissue or a simultaneous issue.

families.name: Homeowner's policy
families.what: The homeowner's policy loading, who may have the policy, and the reissue credit for a prior policy.

families.name: Loan policies
families.what: Expanded coverage and reissue loan policy premiums.

families.name: Reissue
families.what: The reissue rate up to the prior policy amount, the excess in its own bands, and who qualifies.

families.name: Refinance
families.what: Refinance rates on the unpaid balance and on the rest, and the ten-year line.

families.name: Simultaneous issue
families.what: Owner's and loan policies issued together under the revised rule, with excess and aggregate loans.

families.name: Endorsements
families.what: Endorsement premiums as a percentage of the right rate, with their minimums and maximums.

families.name: Which rule applies
families.what: Which reduced-rate rule applies, or none.

families.name: Actuarial memorandum
families.what: The memorandum's proposed premiums, weighted changes and overall rate change, worked again from its own figures.

families.name: Checking the filings
families.what: The filings' own contradictions, such as a later page that differs from the manual, told apart from figures that are right.
